title: GossipSub: Attack-Resilient Message Propagation in the Filecoin and ETH2.0 Networks
note: Primary GossipSub v1.1 paper: mesh + gossip design, peer scoring, Sybil/eclipse/censorship mitigations, evaluated in a 5000-container testbed.

title: Gossipsub-v1.1 Evaluation Report
note: 61-page evaluation of GossipSub v1.1 against Sybil, eclipse, degradation, censorship, cold-boot and cover-flash attacks.

title: Gossipsub v1.1 Protocol Design + Implementation Security Audit Report
venue: Least Authority audit report for Protocol Labs
note: Independent security audit of the GossipSub v1.1 design and Go implementation (June 2020); issues mostly in peer scoring.

title: GossipSub: A Secure PubSub Protocol for Unstructured, Decentralized P2P Overlays
note: Early GossipSub technical report on design choices, requirements, related work and parameters (IPFS/IPNS context); precursor of the 2020 paper; unpublished working draft v0.1 dated 2019-12-30.

title: Formal Model-Driven Analysis of Resilience of GossipSub to Attacks from Misbehaving Peers
note: ACL2s formal model of GossipSub v1.1; proves score-function properties and finds attacks (CVE-2022-47547) on Ethereum config.

title: Verification of GossipSub in ACL2s
note: Verification of GossipSub properties in the ACL2s theorem prover.

title: Staggering and Fragmentation for Improved Large Message Handling in libp2p GossipSub
note: Staggered sending and message fragmentation to cut GossipSub latency and bandwidth for large messages.

title: PREAMBLE and IMRECEIVING for Improved Large Message Handling in libp2p GossipSub
note: Control-message extensions (PREAMBLE, IMRECEIVING) to avoid duplicate large-message transfers in GossipSub.

title: OPTIMUMP2P: Fast and Reliable Gossiping in P2P Networks
note: RLNC-based gossip (Optimum P2P / mump2p) compared with GossipSub in a 36-node geo-distributed A/B test.

title: OPTIMUMP2P Demo: Fast and Reliable Gossiping in P2P Networks
note: Demo paper accompanying OptimumP2P.

title: Topiary: Fast, Scalable Publish/Subscribe for Peer-to-Peer (D)Apps
note: Learns a per-topic p2p topology by multi-armed-bandit neighbour selection; compared against GossipSub-style baselines for dApp pub/sub.

title: SmartPubSub: Content-based Pub-Sub on IPFS
note: Content-based pub/sub on IPFS with two protocols: ScoutSubs (fully decentralized) and FastDelivery (publisher-centred).

title: WAKU-RLN-RELAY: Privacy-Preserving Peer-to-Peer Economic Spam Protection
note: Rate-limiting-nullifier spam protection for a GossipSub-based anonymous relay, with economic slashing.

title: Privacy-Preserving Spam-Protected Gossip-Based Routing
note: Companion paper presenting RLN spam protection for gossip-based routing (the Waku2 relay).

title: Waku: A Family of Modular P2P Protocols For Secure & Censorship-Resistant Communication
note: Overview of the Waku protocol family: libp2p-GossipSub relay plus store, filter and light-push.

title: Discovering the Ethereum2 P2P Network
note: Crawler-based measurement of the Eth2 mainnet overlay, including client mix and GossipSub traffic observations.

title: Deanonymizing Ethereum Validators: The P2P Network Has a Privacy Issue
note: Shows validators can be mapped to IP addresses by observing attestation propagation in GossipSub subnets (15% of validators).

title: Honeybee: Byzantine Tolerant Decentralized Peer Sampling with Verifiable Random Walks
note: Byzantine-tolerant peer sampling; includes a simulation of GossipSub peer discovery with peer exchange.

title: PANDAS: Peer-to-peer, Adaptive Networking for Data Availability Sampling within Ethereum Consensus Timebounds
note: Direct-dissemination p2p design for data availability sampling, contrasted with GossipSub subnets and DHT approaches.

title: Data Availability Sampling in Ethereum: Analysis of P2P Networking Requirements
note: Analyses networking requirements of DAS and the role of GossipSub and DHT-based dissemination.

title: Scalability limitations of Kademlia DHTs when enabling Data Availability Sampling in Ethereum
note: Quantifies Kademlia limits for DAS propagation; the DHT alternative to gossip-based dissemination.

title: Fair and Efficient Gossip in Hyperledger Fabric
note: Redesign of Fabric's push/pull gossip: 10x faster block dissemination, 40% less bandwidth.

title: Optimum Peer-Turbo: A Scalable and Efficient Solution for P2P Broadcasting
note: Coded broadcast for tree/star shard propagation under bounded time windows (Solana/Monad style).

title: Duet: Co-Optimizing P2P Message Propagation and Rotating-Leader Consensus
note: Tree-based reliable broadcast with gossip fallback integrated into Tendermint and libp2p; up to 7.26x throughput over gossip.

title: Techreport: Evaluating Tor-based Location Privacy for Ethereum Validators
note: Evaluates 'Tor push' dissemination integrated with GossipSub to mitigate validator deanonymization.

title: Pub/Sub Dissemination on the XRP Ledger
note: Proposes replacing XRPL flooding of consensus messages with GossipSub-based pub/sub dissemination. Open copy exists at orbilu.uni.lu (pdf_url) but the host's TLS certificate chain fails verification, so it was not downloaded.

title: A 9-dimensional Analysis of GossipSub over the XRP Ledger Consensus Protocol
note: Parameter-space analysis of GossipSub when carrying XRPL consensus traffic. Open copy exists at orbilu.uni.lu (pdf_url) but the host's TLS certificate chain fails verification, so it was not downloaded.

title: Causal AI for XRPL/GossipSub network configuration
note: Causal-inference approach to tuning GossipSub mesh configuration on XRPL. Open copy exists at orbilu.uni.lu (pdf_url) but the host's TLS certificate chain fails verification, so it was not downloaded.

title: XRP-NDN overlay: Improving the Communication Efficiency of Consensus-Validation based Blockchains with an NDN-based Overlay
note: NDN-based overlay to cut XRPL consensus message flooding; sibling to the GossipSub work.

title: Evaluating GossipSub for Data Availability Sampling Under Ethereum Consensus Deadlines
note: Master's thesis evaluating GossipSub for DAS dissemination within slot deadlines.

title: Message Latency in Waku Relay with Rate Limiting Nullifiers
note: Analytic model, 1000-node simulation and 5-site deployment of Waku Relay (GossipSub + RLN) latency.

title: About decentralized swarms of asynchronous distributed cellular automata using inter-planetary file system's publish-subscribe experimental implementation
note: Describes IPFS PubSub models (Floodsub, GossipSub, EpiSub) and measures bandwidth of cellular-automata swarms built on it on Grid'5000.

title: A libP2P Implementation of the Bitcoin Block Exchange Protocol
note: min-bitcoin block exchange on Go libp2p; uses a GossipSub publish-subscribe network to advertise blocks, then direct transfer. Evaluates libp2p in a blockchain setting.

title: Lean Gossip: Big Gains From Small Talk
note: First systematic simulation sweep of GossipSub D and D_lazy under 0-30% churn in 1000 nodes; lean configs dominate Ethereum's deployed settings. Author-hosted preprint.

title: Pulsarcast: Scalable, Reliable Pub-Sub over P2P Nets
note: P2P pub/sub on libp2p with Merkle-DAG event/topic descriptors; higher subscription coverage and lower traffic than Floodsub on Reddit data.

title: Perigee: Efficient Peer-to-Peer Network Design for Blockchains
note: Decentralized bandit-based neighbour selection that cuts blockchain broadcast latency ~33%; the basis for Topiary's topic-aware topology learning.

title: Kadcast: A Structured Approach to Broadcast in Blockchain Networks
note: Kademlia-based structured broadcast with FEC for block propagation; structured alternative to gossip.

title: Kadcast-NG: A Structured Broadcast Protocol for Blockchain Networks
note: Follow-up to Kadcast with improved structured broadcast and analysis.

title: PubSub interface for libp2p
note: Common pubsub wire format and message structures (Active Recommendation, maturity 3A, r3 2020-09-25); no PDF, spec only.

title: gossipsub v1.0: An extensible baseline pubsub protocol
note: GossipSub v1.0 spec: randomized topic meshes plus gossip (Active Recommendation 3A, r2 2020-03-12); no PDF.

title: gossipsub v1.1: Security extensions to improve on attack resilience and bootstrapping
note: GossipSub v1.1 spec: peer scoring, explicit peering, flood publishing, adaptive gossip, peer exchange (Candidate Recommendation, r8 2021-12-14); no PDF.

title: gossipsub v1.2: IDONTWANT control message
note: Backward-compatible v1.1 extension adding IDONTWANT to cut duplicate relays (Working Draft; revision r2 2026-08-30; first PR #548 in 2023); no PDF.

title: gossipsub v1.3: Extensions Control Message
note: Lets peers advertise supported extensions via a control message instead of new protocol IDs (Candidate Recommendation, 2025-06-23); no PDF.

title: Partial Messages Extension
note: Extension for sending only the missing parts of a message (Working Draft r0, 2025-06-23); no PDF.

title: Episub: Proximity Aware Epidemic PubSub for libp2p
note: Draft spec for proximity-aware epidemic broadcast trees (Plumtree-style) on libp2p (Working Draft r1 2018-06-28); no PDF.

title: gossipsub v1.1: Functional Extension for Validation Queue Protection
note: Random Early Drop circuit breaker protecting the validation queue from DoS (Working Draft 1A, 2020-09-05); no PDF.

title: Phase 0 -- Networking (Ethereum consensus-layer p2p interface)
note: Mandates gossipsub v1.1 with global topics and 64 attestation subnets for block and attestation propagation; spec only.

title: The Waku Network as Infrastructure for dApps
note: Architecture of the shared Waku network: relay routing and sharding, discovery, RLN rate limiting, services and incentives.

title: Differentiated Consistency for Worldwide Gossips
note: Gossip dissemination with differentiated consistency levels across worldwide peers; cited by GossipSub large-message work.

title: Multisource Rumor Spreading with Network Coding
note: Network-coded gossip for many simultaneous sources; background for RLNC-based gossip such as OptimumP2P.

title: Probabilistic Edge Multicast Routing for the XRP Network
note: Probabilistic multicast routing at the edge to replace XRPL flooding; precursor to the GossipSub-on-XRPL work.

title: Causal Analysis of GossipSub Mesh Parameters Over the XRP Ledger
note: Causal analysis of GossipSub mesh degree parameters on XRPL traffic.

title: To Squelch or not to Squelch: Enabling Improved Message Dissemination on the XRP Ledger
note: Evaluates XRPL's squelching mechanism for reducing redundant message dissemination; companion to the GossipSub-on-XRPL line.

title: Under the Hood of the Ethereum Gossip Protocol
note: Measurement and analysis of Ethereum's (devp2p-era) gossip protocol: how blocks/transactions spread and its security implications. No open PDF located; Springer paywalled.

title: IPNS PubSub Router
note: IPFS routing spec that publishes and discovers mutable IPNS records over libp2p PubSub with added persistence (status Reliable, 2022-11-09); no PDF.

title: A Formalization of the Correctness of the Floodsub Protocol
note: Machine-checked correctness proof of libp2p Floodsub (delivery to all subscribers) in ACL2s.

title: CliqueSensus: Ephemeral Overlays for Efficient Attestation Dissemination in Ethereum 2.0
note: Ephemeral clique overlays for attestation dissemination as an alternative to GossipSub subnets (Voulgaris is a PolderCast author). ACM page returned 403 to the fetcher, so no PDF; the DOI link is flagged open access by Semantic Scholar.

title: Eth2.0-NA: Modeling Message Propagation to Optimize Mesh Size in Ethereum 2.0 Network
note: Analytic model of GossipSub message propagation used to optimise mesh degree on Ethereum 2.0. No open copy located.

title: Broadcast Mechanisms in Peer-to-Peer Overlay Networks: A Survey and Taxonomy
note: Survey and taxonomy of p2p overlay broadcast, citing GossipSub. IEEE Access is open access but IEEE returned a bot-wall (HTTP 202) to the fetcher, so no PDF.

title: An Analysis of the Impact of Network Delay and Churn on Broadcast Efficiency in GossipSub-based P2P Networks
note: Experimental analysis of delay and churn effects on GossipSub broadcast efficiency. No open copy located.

title: A Node Triple-Based Structural Analysis of Duplicate Message Reception in P2P Broadcast Networks
note: Structural analysis of why gossip-style p2p broadcast yields duplicate receptions. No open copy located.

title: Fully Decentralized Collection of Attestations for Single-Slot Finality in Ethereum
note: Decentralized attestation collection over the p2p layer for single-slot finality. No open copy located.

title: The Streamr Network: Performance and Scalability
venue: Streamr whitepaper / manuscript submitted to IEEE Access (2020-08-20)
note: Decentralized topic-based pub/sub overlay of the Streamr Network (blockchain-incentivised); simulation and real-world latency/scalability evaluation.

title: Multicast Encryption in the Streamr Network
note: End-to-end multicast encryption and key distribution for a decentralised pub/sub network with untrusted relay nodes.
